pieces.title: The living globe
pieces.what: Every experience's doorway is on the one globe at once, alive: a glint from afar, itself closer. Touch one and it starts where you are.
pieces.ask: Can you tell what is here to touch, and what each will be?

pieces.title: Wikipedia's words
pieces.what: The W switch, on: every paragraph the atlas wrote gives way to Wikipedia's own first sentence and a link. Here, for a chosen country.
pieces.ask: Wikipedia's words, or the atlas's own?

pieces.title: The vine's long walk
pieces.what: One vine, eight thousand years long, from a qvevri in Georgia across the world as the years play.
pieces.ask: Does it read as a plant from afar, and as a journey close in?

pieces.title: The quiet globe
pieces.what: Three rules at once: almost no names, clouds that clear where you look, nothing at the foot until you choose a country.

pieces.title: The Earth at night
pieces.what: The ground dark, with the lights of its cities and roads as satellites see them; the clouds a thin veil, the sea still.
pieces.ask: Would you keep this as a look you can switch to?
